title: DXF modeler UID retained owner
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the AcDbModelerGeometry DXF group-2 UID to its parsed owner lease
Preserve replacement, copy/assignment, and reset accounting behavior
Keep the UID opaque and separate from ACIS payload/semantic support claims

implementation.summary: DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseCode now passes DXF group 2 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with a dedicated retained-byte counter. resetDwgState clears the UID/count, while the implicit copy/assignment contract carries the counter and shared entity lease. Added a focused selector that finds the minimum accepted aggregate cap for OLD-to-UID-123, verifies exact-cap success and one-byte-under refusal preserving the previous UID, and tests copied-owner lifetime through final reset.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_ModelerGeometry layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

commands: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md

assessment.claim: The selected DXF parser-owned modeler UID is admitted to the shared logical retained-byte budget, and its charge follows copied model values until final reset/destruction. The UID remains an opaque identifier. This does not bound allocated capacity, process RSS, public mutation, writer-side copies, payload decoding, ACIS semantics, or native acceptance.
assessment.coverage: The generated ASCII direct-parser stream checks minimum-cap discovery, exact-cap success, one-byte-under refusal preserving OLD and its charge, copy construction and assignment, sibling reset, and final release. The owning hardening CTest passes.
assessment.limitations: No full OBJECTS callback stream, persistent/external drawing, peer parser, native CAD application, full suite, allocation benchmark, DWG parser/layout change, or ACIS interpretation was exercised.
